problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: weight 61 tons
* Shipment Beta: weight 56 tons
* Shipment Gamma: weight 59 tons
* Shipment Delta: weight 58 tons
* Shipment Epsilon: weight 53 tons
* Shipment Zeta: weight 30 tons
* Shipment Eta: weight 42 tons
* Shipment Theta: weight 66 tons
* Shipment Iota: weight 43 tons
* Shipment Kappa: weight 34 tons
* Shipment Lambda: weight 61 tons
* Shipment Mu: weight 38 tons
* Shipment Nu: weight 35 tons
* Shipment Xi: weight 63 tons
* Shipment Omicron: weight 65 tons
* Shipment Pi: weight 55 tons
* Shipment Rho: weight 69 tons
* Shipment Sigma: weight 47 tons
* Shipment Tau: weight 43 tons
* Shipment Upsilon: weight 35 tons
* Shipment Phi: weight 57 tons
* Shipment Chi: weight 31 tons
* Shipment Psi: weight 64 tons
* Shipment Omega: weight 60 tons
* Shipment A1: weight 51 tons
* Shipment B1: weight 30 tons
* Shipment C1: weight 42 tons
* Shipment D1: weight 69 tons

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 tons. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total weight on a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
